tools.name: br_company_check
tools.description: Free. Brazilian company (CNPJ) registration check at the Receita Federal: status (ATIVA/BAIXADA/INAPTA...), legal name, CNAE, size, age, normalized address. Structured JSON plus a summary in English and Portuguese, with sources[] and data_freshness. Rate limited (50/day).

tools.name: br_company_search
tools.description: Free. Find a Brazilian company's CNPJ by name (legal or trade name, optional state/UF) in the Receita Federal registry of ACTIVE establishments (monthly dump; individual entrepreneurs/MEI not indexed, query those by CNPJ). tools.name: br_company_count
tools.description: Free. How many ACTIVE Brazilian establishments match a prospecting filter (CNAE code or prefix, state/UF, city, opening date range, headquarters only), from the Receita Federal monthly registry. Use it to budget pages before paying for br_company_list. Rate limited (50/day).

tools.name: br_replay
tools.description: Free. Fetch again, without paying, a paid answer from the last 10 minutes using the receipt.replay_token it carried. Use it when the first response was lost (timeout, disconnect) instead of paying twice.

tools.name: br_batch_sanctions
tools.description: Up to 10 CNPJs in one paid call (one payment, no per-item gas): br_sanctions_screen for each. Per-item errors are reported inline in results[]; the call fails (and is not charged) only when no item succeeds.

tools.name: br_batch_dossier
tools.description: Up to 10 CNPJs in one paid call (one payment, 20% off): br_company_dossier for each. Per-item errors are reported inline in results[]; the call fails (and is not charged) only when no item succeeds.
